news.text: #JUVE, GO GET YOURSELF BLESSEDThe series of injuries does not stop: #Nico and #Çelik KO, #Sarr is at risk for #Lecce.The Argentine (soleus trouble) and the Turk (biceps femoris) are out until the international break, while the Senegalese felt a sharp pain in his adductor: the bianconero players have already missed 59 matches combined due to injury. #Woltemade, drills in the six-yard box: tomorrow he will pair up with #Kolo.[Front Page TuttoSport]
#Juventus are planning to sign a left-back and a forward during the winter transfer window. #transfers[Nico Schira]

📊 #DouglasLuiz, the Brazilian midfielder for #Juventus, is the only player in Serie A with at least 120 carries of five meters or more and at least 120 completed passes that ended in the final third of the pitch.The data comes from Opta and corresponds to this first part of the championship.Specifically, he recorded 121 carries and 161 completed passes in the final third of the pitch.No other Serie A player has achieved that combination so far.[@TUTTOJUVE_COM via @PuebloJ]

🇮🇹🤔 #Gatti is not satisfied with his limited playing time at #Juventus. The 3-man defense could guarantee him more space, but a transfer in January cannot be ruled out if the situation does not change. #CrystalPalace and #Bournemouth are monitoring him, while some Serie A clubs could also come forward.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🚨⏳ Atlético Madrid are open to triggering the €25m buy option for Jonathan David.The 26 y/o striker feels comfortable at Atlético and is also open to staying. Contract at Juventus until 2030.Talks are planned. No final decision yet.@SkySportDE 🇨🇦[Florian Plettenberg]

🧐❗️"Against #Lecce, I expect #Spalletti to deploy the 3-5-2 again with #Kalulu on the right, #Cambiaso on the left and at the back #Gatti-#Bremer-#Lucumi. Furthermore, if you speak with the Juventus management right now, there is complete backing for the bianconero coach, but obviously convincing performances and, above all, positive results are absolutely required."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🇸🇳⁉️ "#Sarr is not at 100%: he has also undergone medical evaluations in the last few hours. He is not injured, unlike Nico #González and #Çelik whom we will see back after the international break, but he is still not 100%."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤⁉️ "There has been talk of interest from #Bologna for #DiGregorio, but he stated that he is happy at #Bournemouth and remains focused, without confirming the rumors. It is important to remember the agreement that includes a potential additional payment to #Juventus in case of a failure to develop him in terms of appearances, but a return to Italy in January or in the summer should not be ruled out. For now, however, the goalkeeper calls for calm."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👨‍🦲🆙 "Following the draw against #Rennes, confidence in #Spalletti continues to hold. The club is giving him time and does not want to constantly change managers every year. However, his position is not guaranteed 101%: he needs to reverse the course, return to winning consistently and look convincing on the pitch. The trust remains, but a change of pace is necessary."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

It will be a carefully considered decision, one I will make when I believe the conditions are right.I have read reports of financial demands and requests for full control that I have supposedly already made to the clubs mentioned, as well as reservations about what has been described as my “strong personality”. These reports are unfounded, as there is currently no concrete basis for such assessments
